## GangAddMember {#gangaddmember}

```lua
GangAddMember(gang, index, human)
```

| # | Argument | Read as | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `gang` | number, truncated to an integer | Gang id (slot 0-31); -1 does nothing. |
| 2 | `index` | number, truncated to an integer | Read but not used by the C++ side; the scripts pass 0 or -1. |
| 3 | `human` | number, truncated to an unsigned integer | Handle of the human to add. |

**Returns** nothing.

Moves a human into a gang: it leaves its previous gang (its goals and actions are flushed), takes the gang's
invincibility setting and may become its leader. If the gang is full (10 members, 16 for police) a member is dropped
first.

**Notes.** 0x00166308.

```lua
GangAddSpawner(gang, name, arg3, types, model, pos, heading, total, delay, maxConcurrent, kind, target, arg13, callback, value, arg16, anim)
```

| # | Argument | Read as | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `gang` | number, truncated to an integer | Gang id (slot 0-31) that owns the spawner and receives the spawned humans; -1 does nothing. |
| 2 | `name` | string | Name of the spawner, used by GangStartSpawner and the other spawner bindings. |
| 3 | `arg3` | number, truncated to an integer | A number stored with the spawner (the scripts pass 0); meaning not traced. |
| 4 | `types` | table of 10 numbers (t[1]..t[10]) | Table of up to 10 character type ids the spawner picks from (the scripts pass lists such as CharGenSpawner1). |
| 5 | `model` | string | Name of the model/outfit the spawned characters use (such as "warr_sw"); GangSetSpawnerModel changes it. |
| 6 | `pos` | table of 3 numbers (t[1]..t[3]) | Spawn position {x, y, z} in world units (metres). |
| 7 | `heading` | number, truncated to an integer | Heading of the spawned characters, in degrees. |
| 8 | `total` | number, truncated to an integer | How many characters the spawner makes in all; the scripts use -1 for no limit (inferred). |
| 9 | `delay` | number, truncated to an unsigned integer | Delay between spawns, in milliseconds (the scripts pass 1, 500 or 1000) (inferred). |
| 10 | `maxConcurrent` | number, truncated to an integer | How many of its characters may be alive at once (spawner +0x5a; GangSetMaxConcurrent changes it). |
| 11 | `kind` | number, truncated to an integer | Spawner behaviour id (spawner +0x52): 2 is timed (it starts a timer of value seconds); 4 and others select other behaviours not traced. |
| 12 | `target` | number, truncated to an unsigned integer | A handle stored with the spawner (the scripts pass NilHandle); meaning not traced. |
| 13 | `arg13` | number, truncated to an integer | A number stored with the spawner (the scripts pass 0); meaning not traced. |
| 14 | `callback` | string | Name of a Lua function called for each character spawned, or nil. |
| 15 | `value` | number, truncated to an integer | A number used by the behaviour (seconds for the timed kind 2); GangStartSpawner's last argument replaces it. |
| 16 | `arg16` | number, truncated to an unsigned integer | A handle stored with the spawner (the scripts pass NilHandle); meaning not traced. |
| 17 | `anim` | string | Name of an animation or behaviour given to spawned characters; "nothing" for none (inferred). |

**Returns** nothing.

Adds a spawner to a gang: a point that creates gang members over time from a list of character types. A gang has at most
4 spawners; the call is ignored when all four are used. The spawner does nothing until GangStartSpawner starts it.

**Notes.** 0x0016aec0 → 0x00166ff8. The layout (which argument goes to which spawner field) is confirmed (code); the
meaning of the numeric arguments is inferred from the stored fields and the scripts' values. Default per-spawner timers
(10, 20, 30, 60 ...) are set at creation.

## GangCreate {#gangcreate}

```lua
GangCreate(type, name, flag1, flag2) -> number
```

| # | Argument | Read as | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `type` | number, truncated to an integer | Gang type id (stored at gang +0x2c): selects the gang's configuration from the gang table (the CfgGang data); 0 is the Warriors and 1 the police. Type 1 also makes the new police gang enemies of every gang that is currently wanted. |
| 2 | `name` | string | Unique name of the gang (up to about 28 characters); creation fails if a gang with this name already exists. |
| 3 | `flag1` | boolean (nil or 0 is false) | Read but not used by the C++ side (0x0016cdf0 takes only the type and the name). |
| 4 | `flag2` | boolean (nil or 0 is false) | Read but not used, as flag1. |

**Returns** number: The new gang's id (slot 0-31), or -1 when the name is already in use or all 32 slots are taken.

Creates a gang: takes a free slot, gives it a name and a type, clears its members and spawners, and sets up the type's
default animation and response tables. Members are added afterwards (HuCreate's gang argument, GangAddMember, spawners).

**Notes.** 0x0016cdf0. A gang holds at most 10 members, or 16 for police (type 1) and type 0x17 (0x00166308).

- **Evidence:** confirmed (code) at `0x0016a1c8`; detail: traced
- **Wrapper** `0x00373148` (registered by `RegisterBindings`); **calls** `0x0016a1c8`
